items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And that's when I did the command performance for General Eisenhower.

ctx.x: The next unit, they came back, they sent me out, the ETO. That was the European Theater of Operations. Went all through France and England and Germany and all those places.

And that's when I did the command performance for General Eisenhower. They sent a plane to Nancy, France and took me to Frankfurt, Germany, to the command headquarters, where Marshall Zukov presented General Eisenhower with a medal, you know, and Field Marshall Montgomery was there. He was one of the people. And I didn't know, you know, I've always had a lot of nerve. I went up and asked all of them for their autographs. I have all their autographs. Yeah.
